decision_question: Can the source-linked factual-QA method produce a trustworthy 40-case pilot from eligible Academia Vault teaching material across text, code, multi-source, table, diagram, other multimodal, no-evidence, cross-course, and integrity cases?

source_universe.required_disposition: every selected source must have an explicit eligible role, exact content hash, permission, course identity, modality, version, and local locator before case authoring

prerequisite_gates: factual-qa-v3-scale-rehearsal-005 passes unseen paired-defect reviewer sensitivity and human audit
all 40 cases bind only explicit eligible exact-hash sources
questions target claims required evidence and source locators complete manual verification
provider fields retention call count cost and failure behavior frozen prospectively
clean repository and no-call preflight passes
separate bounded paid execution authorization recorded

case_design.source_sampling: stratify across eligible courses and modalities; do not repeatedly sample one document when alternatives exist
case_design.ground_truth: researcher-verified target claims with exact source-level evidence quotes and locators

product_path.citation_contract: exact source version locator quote and claim binding
product_path.raw_image_claim_boundary: multimodal claims require actual page or region evidence; accessibility text may assist but cannot silently replace image evaluation

provider_data_policy.collection_and_retention: allowed only for exact eligible source excerpts and generated evaluation fields in this named pilot
provider_data_policy.git_publication: sanitized manifests aggregate metrics summaries and approved examples only

human_audit.selection: every deterministic failure and unresolved disagreement first, then controls spanning all slices and at least four courses
human_audit.authority: human source verification and deterministic lineage override model agreement
